# Mauldin Village Apartments

> Mauldin Village is a 48-home apartment community at 5418 Mauldin Avenue, Columbia, SC 29203 (North Columbia), offering renovated 1, 2, and 3 bedroom apartment homes. It is owned and managed by Braden Fellman Group, a real estate firm that has developed and managed communities in-house since 1981.

## Key Facts

- Address: 5418 Mauldin Avenue, Columbia, SC 29203 (North Columbia, near the North Main Street corridor)
- Community size: 48 apartment homes in low-rise, two-story buildings
- Floor plans:
  - 1 Bedroom / 1 Bath — 750 sq ft — from $900/month (8 homes)
  - 2 Bedroom / 1 Bath — 854 sq ft — from $1,095/month (24 homes)
  - 3 Bedroom / 1 Bath — 1,052 sq ft — from $1,295/month (16 homes)
- Application fee: $100 per applicant, online via AppFolio (https://bradenfellman.appfolio.com/listings)
- Status: being renovated home by home; now leasing
- Management: Braden Fellman Group (in-house ownership, renovation, and management)
- Office hours: Monday–Friday 9:00am–5:00pm
- Phone: (470) 226-1848 · Email: mauldin@bradenfellman.com
- Equal Housing Opportunity

## Location Highlights

- ~10 minutes to downtown Columbia's Main Street
- Near Columbia College and Prisma Health Richland (both in the 29203)
- Close to Earlewood Park, the BullStreet District / Segra Park, Riverfront Park, and the University of South Carolina
